pieces.Text: Your shape changes to that of a Large monkey (as per the dire ape; Bestiary p17). While in this form, you gain a climb speed of

feet, low-light vision, and scent (30 feet), two claw attacks (1d6 damage), a bite attack (1d6 damage), and you can still use your hands to wield weapons, hold objects, and manipulate objects normally.
You can use your tail to hold and manipulate objects as if you had a third hand, but you cannot use it to wield weapons or shields.
You gain a rend attack that deals extra damage equal to that of your shifter claws attack plus 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus when you hit with two of your normal shifter claws attacks.
